name: aeitron
description: Natural language control for Aeitron's intelligent edge network, DNS routing, and workload placement.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Retrieve user profile, organization, subscription tier, and resource quota limits.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects accessible to the tenant with pagination support.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Retrieve detailed deployment health, attached custom domains, and edge telemetry for a specific project.

tools.name: get_dns_records
tools.description: Fetch active DNS records for an authorized domain zone.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Summarize bandwidth, request counts, compute hours, and financial totals.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Provision a new project workspace on the Aeitron edge.

tools.name: create_dns_record
tools.description: Add a new DNS record to an authorized domain zone.

tools.name: delete_dns_record
tools.description: Permanently delete a DNS record from the domain zone (Requires explicit safety confirmation).
